sections.Profile:
The "Family Guy" pinball machine, designed by Pat Lawlor and released by Stern in 2007, features an entertaining layout that captures the essence of the popular animated series. It includes voice work by series creator Seth MacFarlane, adding authenticity and humor to the gameplay. Key elements include the "Stewie's Mini Pinball," a mini playfield with its own set of flippers and shots, and various modes inspired by episodes from the show, such as "TV Challenge," "Beer Can," and "Stewie's Pinball". ​ The "Shrek" pinball machine, released by Stern in 2008, reuses the playfield design from the "Family Guy" machine but with a different theme.
